description: How the Android and iOS runners treat a daemon retryAfterMs hint (#11544); both read this table and must give the same answer. usableHints: a wire hint becomes the hint the runner uses (null = absent): zero and negative count as absent, anything above the 150000 ms finalize cap is clamped to it. backoffSteps: the next wait for a refusal, given the waits already taken and the ms already waited, as (waits, waitedMs, hint, code) -> delayMs, null once the budget is spent; the default 30000 ms budget applies, and a finalize code's hint bounds the total wait instead of lengthening a step. finalizeWait: the codes whose retryAfterMs bounds the total wait (device_cleanup_in_progress carries the finalize time still remaining, device_shutting_down a polling hint), and the longest any client (MCP proxy, JUnit runner, XCTestRunner) waits one out (#11360); each client's own constant must equal waitBudgetMs, and the daemon's bounded cleanups never advertise more.
